name: Google AX
description: Runs sandboxed agentic tasks at cluster scale from declarative YAML Task, Workspace, and Model manifests on Agent Substrate, with a kubectl-style CLI for platform teams.

skills.name: Task Lifecycle Management
skills.description: Applies, lists, describes, watches, suspends, resumes, and deletes sandboxed agent tasks with ax commands or the AX gRPC service.

skills.name: Workspace Provisioning
skills.description: Pre-wires Git repositories, MCP servers, and skill packages into every sandbox so each agent task starts with its workspace ready.

skills.name: Model Configuration
skills.description: Declares which LLM provider and model the platform uses, with credentials pulled from a Kubernetes secret, via Model manifests.

skills.name: Sandbox Shell Access
skills.description: Opens an interactive shell or runs one-off commands inside a running debug-enabled task sandbox with the ax ssh command.
